title: L4: Binary Mine 3D
description: The 3D voxel version of Binary Mine. Orbit a block world, mine and build in three dimensions, and keep combining elements — combining is still binary addition. Climb the class leaderboard.

steps.title: Binary Mine 3D
steps.content:
Binary Mine 3D

Same game, now in 3D. Every block is an element with a binary code, and combining two elements is still binary addition — the two codes add together to make a new element. Drag to rotate the world, scroll to zoom.

Mine
Left-click a block
Build
Right-click a block face
Combine
0110 + 1100 = 10010
Goal
Discover the highest element
